title: Create a Personal Database
prompt: Create a database containing students(identifier, name, course, enrollment_date). Insert at least ten rows, retrieve all students, and sort alphabetically.
objective: Apply the SQLite concepts in create a personal database and produce verifiable evidence.

starter.code:

expected_output: Ten or more students appear in deterministic alphabetical order.
acceptance_criteria: Addresses every explicit requirement in the task: Create a database containing students(identifier, name, course, enrollment_date). Insert at least ten rows, retrieve all students, and sort alphabetically.
Ten or more students appear in deterministic alphabetical order.

hints: Start with a tiny known dataset; write the intended schema and expected rows first.

grading_method: Server-side source-string checks are only a minimal rubric and do not execute arbitrary SQL. Verify SQL in a local SQLite CLI/API; performance, recovery and architecture tasks require human review.
retry_policy: Retries are allowed. Incorrect submissions award no XP; completion/reward idempotency remains backend-owned.
